description: Benchmark task (docs/benchmark_rules.md). Five-stage current-starved ring VCO with diode source degeneration and 'charge-pump' stages (paper Fig. 5), gpdk090, run at 1.2 V instead of the paper's 1.8 V (device rating, D9), 10 fF load (RV5), control range 0.45-1.2 V chosen by simulation (RV2). Conditions: nominal (TT = NN, 27 C) plus the paper's two one-at-a-time sweeps: process FF / FS / SS / SF at 27 C (Figs. 9-10) and temperature -65 / -45 / 45 / 65 C at TT (Figs. 11, 12, 14). Phase noise / FoM / power at the Vcon giving the mid frequency (f(0.45 V) + f(1.2 V)) / 2, found per design and condition from a PSS sweep (RV4). Frequency targets are the paper's 1.8 V values scaled to 1.2 V by k_f = 0.5880 (RV3b; owner-approved 2026-10-23: k_f = reference design's simulated f at the top of the control range, 368.15 MHz at VDD 1.2 V / Vcon 1.2 V, divided by 626.08 MHz at VDD 1.8 V / Vcon 1.6 V; same PSS testbench, NN, 27 C, 10 fF). Ratio targets (fmax/fmin, TR %) are supply-invariant and not scaled; power and phase-noise targets are not scaled (owner answer scales frequency only; the Monte Carlo power mean is an upper bound, owner 2026-10-23). Monte Carlo (mismatch) at the fixed control voltage 0.825 V, the middle of the control range (paper Figs. 15-17: fixed Vcon 1.05 V; definition audit 2026-10-27). G8 does not apply to the ring (its DC equilibrium is not its operating point; owner 2026-10-23).

source.title: Khan et al., 'Wideband and Linear Current Starved VCO with Source Degeneration and Integrated Charge Pump for ADC Front Ends', QPAIN 2025
source.figure: Fig. 5 (five-stage current-starved ring: global bias M11/M22/M23, starving M1/3/5 and M17/19/21, 'charge-pump' stages 2/4 with M2/M4/M18/M20, diode degeneration M24-M28, C1/C3/C5 = CLOAD, C2/C4 = CPUMP to VCON); sizes Table I (p. 3)

variables.name: N_M11
variables.role: fingers of M11 (diode-connected PMOS of the global bias, sets PBIAS for the PMOS starving mirror)

variables.name: N_PS
variables.role: fingers of the PMOS starving devices M1 = M3 = M5 (gate PBIAS)

variables.name: N_PCP
variables.role: fingers of the charge-pump PMOS M2 = M4 (gate VSS, fully on)

variables.name: N_PI
variables.role: fingers of the inverter PMOS M6-M10 (Table I group, incl. charge-pump switches M7/M9)

variables.name: N_NI
variables.role: fingers of the inverter NMOS M12-M16 (Table I group)

variables.name: N_NS
variables.role: fingers of the NMOS starving devices M17 = M19 = M21 (gate VCON, the tuning)

variables.name: N_NCP
variables.role: fingers of the charge-pump NMOS M18 = M20 (gate VDD, fully on)

variables.name: N_M22
variables.role: fingers of M22 (global current sink, gate VCON, converts VCON into the PBIAS mirror current)

variables.name: N_DG
variables.role: fingers of the diode-connected degeneration NMOS M24-M28 (linearise f (VCON))

variables.name: N_M23
variables.role: fingers of M23 (diode-connected degeneration of the global bias branch)

variables.name: C_LOAD
variables.role: C1 = C3 = C5 stage load capacitors (set the tuning range with the starved current)

variables.name: C_PUMP
variables.role: C2 = C4 charge-pump stage capacitors (N2/N4 to VCON, as drawn, RV1)

constraints.name: centre_f_lower
constraints.aggregate: worst case over all conditions and matching points
constraints.provenance: consolidation_2026_10_27 (rule G5, schematic over post-layout): the paper's centre frequency is the middle of the tuning range (329 MHz = (38 + 619)/2 post-layout, abstract / p. 4; Table II 323 MHz), so the schematic centre is (39 + 697)/2 = 368 MHz (p. 3 schematic range, the same range as the f_low_end / f_high_end targets); x k_f 0.5880 (RV3b, owner_approved_2026-10-23) -> 216.38 MHz; two-sided. constraints.name: fom_centre
constraints.aggregate: worst case over all conditions and matching points
constraints.provenance: consolidation_2026_10_27 (G6 step 2): the paper's -141.15 dBc/Hz is a VDD 1.8 V figure (L -87.92, Pdiss 524.4 uW, centre 329 MHz: -87.92 + 10 log(0.5244) - 20 log(329) = -141.07) and is not like-for-like at the task's 1.2 V supply, where the frequency targets are scaled by k_f. Target = the paper's FoM formula (abstract / p. 4 eq., FoM = L + 10 log(Pdiss/1 mW) - 20 log(f0/df)) applied to the paper's phase noise -87.92 dBc/Hz and power 524.4 uW (both unscaled targets of this task) at the task's centre-frequency target 216.38 MHz: -137.43 dBc/Hz. Was -141.15
